subject: Cascade Analytics renewal + expansion — MSA redlines & orderform consolidation
messages:
From: Tina Fisher <tfisher@cascade.com>

Subject: Cascade renewal + capacity add — redlines attached

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Cascade is ready to move forward with a 36-month renewal and an uplift from 50 to 150 concurrent inference units (CIUs). We've attached our redlines to the MSA and a purchase order for the expanded capacity. High level items we want to resolve before signature:

- Data retention: we prefer a 90-day KV/cache retention and a 12-month audit log export window.
- Indemnity carveouts for open-source model IP.
- Termination for convenience: request a 90-day notice with pro-rated refund for prepaid capacity.

Attached: Cascade_Redlines_MSA.docx, Cascade_PO_2026.pdf

Can you confirm Redwood's stance on the indemnity language and whether we can consolidate the exhibits into a single addendum to simplify future amendments? Also propose an ETA for a consolidated order form that shows the new capacity and billing cadence.

Appreciate it — Tina

Tina Fisher
Head of Procurement | Cascade Analytics

2) Priyom will validate the capacity/ops impact and confirm the provisioning lead time for 150 CIUs.

Date: 2026-12-02T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Cascade redlines — initial legal read

Kim / Priyom — initial read of Cascade's redlines (attached to their email). Key items and proposed positions:

- Indemnity: Customer wants a carveout that excludes open-source model IP. We should offer a limited mutual indemnity for third-party IP claims where Redwood's delivery modifies or redistributes third-party models; decline broad carveouts. Proposed language: mutual indemnity with specific carveouts for models explicitly listed in Exhibit B.

- Data retention / audit: 90-day KV retention is operationally possible as a config, but the 12-month export window for audit logs needs discussion (cost + storage). Recommend: 90-day default KV + 12-month audit export available as paid add-on.

- Termination for convenience: 90-day notice is ok; pro-rated refunds for prepaid capacity acceptable only for unused committed units (not for non-refundable discounts). Will need finance signoff on refund math.

- Consolidation of exhibits: neutral. Consolidating into a single addendum simplifies future adjustments; propose a single "Order Schedule" addendum that enumerates exhibits.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura will prepare redline responses on Tuesday 12/2 and share a tracked MSA (will include rationale comments).
- Priyom to confirm provisioning SLA and effective date options (will reply inline).

On the procurement ask to consolidate exhibits, we should include a clause that allows Redwood to reference model-specific technical details in a separate, editable tech exhibit to avoid re-negotiating the core MSA for model swaps.

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Elena Morozova <elena.m@cascade.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Tina Fisher <tfisher@cascade.com>, Procurement <procure@cascade.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cascade renewal + capacity add — redlines attached

Laura / Kim — thanks for the quick reply. Attached is an annotated copy of our MSA where we've flagged the indemnity + termination language and suggested alternative wording (see Cascade_MSA_annotated.pdf). A few clarifications from our side:

- Mutual indemnity is acceptable, but Cascade requires express protection against claims that arise from Redwood's hosted delivery using third-party models we license. We are not asking for blanket IP indemnity for all open-source models — only for situations where Redwood modifies or bundles third-party IP and that causes a claim.

- The 12-month audit log export window is a strict compliance requirement for our audit team; if export is provided as a paid add-on, we need to understand the cost and timeline to import logs into our archive.

- Consolidation into a single addendum is preferred; it makes our procurement team's review faster. If Redwood needs a separate tech exhibit for model swaps, we are open to a concise note in the addendum that preserves our right to review material changes.

We can do 09:30 PT on Thursday 12/03 for a short call. Please send the consolidated order form and a tracked MSA before then so our counsel can review.

Thanks, Elena

Elena Morozova
Senior Counsel, Cascade Analytics
elena.m@cascade.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Tina Fisher <tfisher@cascade.com>, Elena Morozova <elena.m@cascade.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-03T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cascade renewal + capacity add — redlines attached

Hi Tina / Elena — appreciate the annotated MSA and the clarity on the audit requirement. Per today's internal review and finance check, attached is a consolidated order form and a short cover note: Redwood_Cascade_Orderform_v3.pdf. Summary of changes we propose:

- Indemnity: propose mutual indemnity with a narrowly tailored clause covering claims arising from Redwood's modifications or redistribution of third-party models; accepts customer-supplied model carveouts with explicit listing in Exhibit B.
- Data retention / audit exports: default KV retention = 90 days (configurable); 12-month audit export available as a one-time paid export or as part of an expanded observability package. I'll include estimated cost in the follow-up email.
- Termination: 90-day notice for convenience; pro-rated refunds limited to unused committed CIUs. Non-refundable discounts remain non-pro-rated.
- Order form: reflects 36-month term, start date 2027-01-01, 150 CIUs, monthly billing with an up-front commitment credit applied.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached order form and tell us whether the start date and billing cadence work for you.
- If the high-level indemnity/data positions are acceptable, Laura and Elena can work to iron out the precise tracked language on the MSA during the call.
- I'll schedule the 09:30 PT call for 2026-12-03 and share a calendar invite.

Thanks all — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
